content.value_statement: Incorrect rule frontmatter can prevent project instructions from loading as intended. This skill guides valid paths syntax, glob patterns, global rules, and Cursor migrations.
actual_capabilities: Explains the paths frontmatter required for path-scoped Claude rules.
Shows single and multiple quoted glob patterns for common repository layouts.
Distinguishes global rules from path-scoped rules.
Identifies Cursor-only globs, alwaysApply, and description fields.
Provides an example directory structure with recursive rule discovery.
limitations: Provides guidance only and does not validate rule loading at runtime.
Does not inspect a repository unless the user supplies its files or layout.
Examples focus on TypeScript, tests, Markdown, and common source directories.
Does not cover every Claude configuration feature outside modular rules.

prompt_templates.title: Create a global rule
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a global Claude rule for [project convention]. Place it under .claude/rules and explain why paths frontmatter is unnecessary.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a repository-wide convention

prompt_templates.title: Create a scoped rule

prompt_templates.title: Audit a rule structure

output_examples.input: Convert a Cursor rule that uses globs and alwaysApply.
output_examples.output: Cursor-only fields are removed, scoped patterns are moved to Claude paths frontmatter, and each glob is quoted. The original rule intent remains unchanged.

output_examples.input: Review rules for source files and tests.
output_examples.output: The review separates source and test scopes, identifies overlapping patterns, and recommends clear filenames under organized subdirectories.

best_practices: Quote every glob pattern in YAML frontmatter.
Omit paths frontmatter when a rule should apply globally.
Use descriptive filenames and subdirectories to organize related conventions.
anti_patterns: Do not use the Cursor-only globs field in Claude rules.
Do not add alwaysApply for repository-wide Claude rules.
Do not leave glob patterns unquoted in YAML.

faq.question: Where should Claude rule files be stored?
faq.answer: Store them as Markdown files under .claude/rules. Subdirectories are supported and discovered recursively.

faq.question: Which frontmatter field scopes a rule?
faq.answer: Use paths with one quoted glob or a list of quoted globs.

faq.question: How do I create a global rule?
faq.answer: Omit paths frontmatter. The rule then applies without file-specific scope.

faq.question: Can I use Cursor globs and alwaysApply fields?
faq.answer: No. Replace globs with paths, and omit paths instead of using alwaysApply for global behavior.

faq.question: Must glob patterns be quoted?
faq.answer: Yes. Quoting prevents YAML from interpreting special glob characters incorrectly.

faq.question: Does this skill execute commands or contact services?
faq.answer: No. It provides written guidance and links to official Claude documentation for reference.
